html:
D124　按审批快照执行关单

第 18 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D123-关单申请与独立审批。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

让已批准的申请实际关闭工单。发起人只提交申请编号，服务端从冻结快照中取工单、版本和处理说明，复用普通接口的流转代码完成一次关闭。

执行入口为 POST /api/agent/close-requests/:id/execute。请求体为空对象。操作成功后对比普通关单的状态、处理记录、审计和缓存失效逻辑；另查审批记录是否从 approved 变成 executed。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/src/agent/agent.module.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.controller.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts
★ apps/server/src/tickets/tickets.module.ts
★ apps/server/src/tickets/tickets.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 10 分钟，知识点 35 分钟，动手 55 分钟，自检与提交 20 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D123　审批为什么要记录工单版本？

核对答案

版本把批准决定绑定到审批人看见的工单状态。

D121　资源换租后怎样处理旧详情？

核对答案

用当前租户、当前资源归属和所有者再次核对。

D117　限流、超时和熔断能保证写操作幂等吗？

核对答案

它们可以限制消耗；业务去重还需要唯一键或带旧状态的条件更新。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 通过同一业务服务执行关单

在可串行化事务里重查发起人和审批人的权限与租户，消费一次批准，再调用状态机的版本更新、追加处理记录和审计。统计缓存仍在事务提交后失效。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts -t "并发执行只关闭一次并留下两位参与人的审计"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('并发执行只关闭一次并留下两位参与人的审计', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const id = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id;
    const base = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + id;
    await api.post(base + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201);
    const execute = () => api.post(base + '/execute').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({});
    const receipts = await Promise.all([execute(), execute()]);
    expect(receipts.map(r => r.status).sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual([201, 409]);
    const events = await db.ticketEvent.findMany({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } });
    expect(events).toHaveLength(1); expect(events[0].content).toBe(flow.terms.comment);
    const audit = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo } });
    expect(audit.map(r => [r.action, r.actorUsername])).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
      ['agent.close_requested','bob'], ['agent.close_approved','carol'], ['agent.close_executed','bob'], ['ticket.close','bob'],
    ]));
  });

推导题　两个浏览器同时点击执行会发生什么？

答案

两个请求争用同一批准和工单版本，只有一个可以提交；另一个遇到状态冲突。查数据库应只多一条处理记录和一条执行审计。

1.2 把过期意图保留为可解释的冲突

审批后工单可能又被修改。沿用普通流转的版本比较，版本不同就回滚整个事务。执行请求没有工单号、说明或版本参数，客户端不能在执行时替换审批内容。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts -t "工单版本变化会回滚审批消费和执行审计"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('工单版本变化会回滚审批消费和执行审计', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const id = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id;
    const base = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + id;
    await api.post(base + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201);
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: flow.ticket.id }, data: { version: { increment: 1 } } });
    await api.post(base + '/execute').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(409);
    expect((await db.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } })).state).toBe('approved');
    expect(await db.auditLog.count({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo, action: 'agent.close_executed' } })).toBe(0);
  });

推导题　为什么版本冲突时申请还应显示 approved？

答案

申请确实经过批准，但这次执行没有完成。回滚待消费标记与执行审计能保留事实。用户需要基于新版本另行发起申请。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　复用工单流转事务

提示一 · 方向

先列出普通关单的全部副作用。

提示二 · API

TicketsService.transition、planTransition、ticketEvent、audit.record。

提示三 · 实现顺序

把实时授权回调放进可串行化事务，取回该账号的资源条件，再执行原状态机。

步骤 2　通过两次并发提交核对原子性

提示一 · 方向

同时发出两次有效申请的执行请求。

提示二 · API

Promise.all、updateMany、version。

提示三 · 实现顺序

查两个响应、工单状态和 ticketEvent 行数；再改动工单版本观察整笔事务回滚。

三、自检与提交

保留两个并发响应、一次成功后的操作记录以及版本冲突后的审批状态。按申请编号把申请人、复核人和实际执行人串成时间线。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts 把 action: 'agent.close_executed' 临时替为 action: 'agent.close_receipt'，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected [ …(4) ] to deeply equal ArrayContaining{…}

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts 把 version: row.version, comment: row.comment 临时替为 version: row.version - 1, comment: row.comment，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected [ 409, 409 ] to deeply equal [ 201, 409 ]

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D124 提交了”。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.controller.ts

import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, Param, ParseUUIDPipe, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { CloseApprovalService } from './close-approval.service.js';

@Controller('agent')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class CloseApprovalController {
  constructor(private readonly approvals: CloseApprovalService) {}
  @Post('runs/:id/close-requests')
  submit(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    return this.approvals.submit(user.id, id, input);
  }
  @Get('close-requests/:id')
  inspect(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.approvals.review(user.id, id);
  }
  @Post('close-requests/:id/execute')
  execute(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    if (!z.object({}).strict().safeParse(input ?? {}).success) throw new BadRequestException('执行只接受申请编号');
    return this.approvals.execute(user.id, id);
  }
  @Post('close-requests/:id/approve')
  approve(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    if (!z.object({}).strict().safeParse(input ?? {}).success) throw new BadRequestException('只接受申请编号');
    return this.approvals.review(user.id, id, true);
  }
}

apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts

import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketsService } from '../tickets/tickets.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { decideTool } from './agent-permission.js';

const terms = z.object({ requestKey: z.uuid(), version: z.number().int().min(0), comment: z.string().trim().min(1).max(500) }).strict();
export async function authorizedTarget(tx: TransactionClient, actor: string, ticketNo: string, tenantKey: string, review = false) {
  const { user } = await readAccess(tx, actor).catch((error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') throw new ForbiddenException();
    throw error;
  });
  if (user.tenantKey !== tenantKey) throw new NotFoundException();
  if (decideTool(user.permissions ?? [], 'closure', 'close_ticket') !== 'approval' ||
    (review && !user.permissions?.includes('ticket:approve-close'))) throw new ForbiddenException();
  const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo }, select: { version: true, status: true } });
  if (!ticket) throw new NotFoundException();
  return { user, ticket };
}

@Injectable()
export class CloseApprovalService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly audit: AuditService, private readonly tickets: TicketsService) {}

  async submit(actor: string, runId: string, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = terms.safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('关单申请参数无效');
    const { requestKey, version, comment } = parsed.data;
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: actor } });
      if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, run.ticketNo, run.tenantKey);
      const data = { runId, requesterId: actor, requestKey, tenantKey: run.tenantKey,
        ticketNo: run.ticketNo, version, comment, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000) };
      const previous = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (previous) {
        if (previous.version !== version || previous.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
        return previous;
      }
      if (ticket.version !== version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('工单状态或版本已变化');
      const inserted = await tx.closeApproval.createMany({ data, skipDuplicates: true });
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (row.version !== version || row.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
      if (inserted.count) await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_requested',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: run.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: row.id, version } });
      return row;
    });
  }

  async execute(actor: string, id: string) {
    // 外层只取不可变参数；权限、版本、过期和单次消费在业务事务中重新检查。
    const row = await this.db.closeApproval.findFirst({ where: { id, requesterId: actor } });
    if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
    const owner = await this.db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: actor }, select: { username: true } });
    // 工单主键来自冻结快照，实际可见性在回调内按最新账号和班组复核。
    return this.tickets.transition(row.ticketNo, { action: 'close', version: row.version, comment: row.comment },
      owner.username, {}, async (tx, actorId) => {
        if (actorId !== actor) throw new ForbiddenException();
        const current = await tx.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
        if (current.state !== 'approved' || !current.reviewerId || current.reviewerId === actor) throw new ConflictException('需要有效审批');
        const { user } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey);
        await authorizedTarget(tx, current.reviewerId, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey, true);
        const changed = await tx.closeApproval.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'approved', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
          data: { state: 'executed' } });
        if (!changed.count) throw new ConflictException('审批已失效');
        await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_executed',
          entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: id, reviewerId: current.reviewerId, version: row.version } });
        return agentScope(user);
      });
  }

  async review(actor: string, id: string, approve = false) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey, true);
      if (row.requesterId === actor) throw new ForbiddenException('需要另一位审批人');
      if (!approve) return row;
      if (ticket.version !== row.version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('需要重新申请');
      const change = await tx.closeApproval.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'pending', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { state: 'approved', reviewerId: actor } });
      if (!change.count) throw new ConflictException('申请已过期或已处理');
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_approved',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: id, version: row.version } });
      return { ...row, reviewerId: actor, state: 'approved' };
    });
  }
}

import { ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { TicketStatus } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import type { GroupScope } from '../auth/group-scope.js';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor } from '../common/cursor.js';
import { OutboxService } from '../notifications/outbox.service.js';
import { redactForLog } from '../common/sensitive.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import type { BatchAssignDto } from './dto/batch-assign.dto.js';
import type { CommentTicketDto } from './dto/comment-ticket.dto.js';
import type { ListTicketsQuery } from './dto/list-tickets.query.js';
import type { ReassignTicketDto } from './dto/reassign-ticket.dto.js';
import type { TransitionTicketDto } from './dto/transition-ticket.dto.js';
import { TicketStatsService } from './ticket-stats.service.js';
import { InvalidTransitionError, planTransition } from './ticket-workflow.js';

// 工单详情页需要的字段。用 select 白名单，不用 include：
// include 会带出关联表的全部列，表上以后新增的字段也会自动出现在接口里
const ticketDetailSelect = {
  ticketNo: true,
  // 版本号：前端修改工单时原样带回，用来发现基于过期页面的修改（D10 乐观锁）
  version: true,
  title: true,
  description: true,
  status: true,
  priority: true,
  slaDueAt: true,
  resolvedAt: true,
  closedAt: true,
  createdAt: true,
  device: { select: { code: true, name: true, location: true } },
  // 手机号方便联系提单人和处理人；返回前由 MaskingInterceptor 按权限脱敏（D19）
  reporter: { select: { username: true, displayName: true, phone: true } },
  assignee: { select: { username: true, displayName: true, phone: true } },
  // 处理记录按时间正序，同一时刻的按 id（UUID v7 按时间递增）兜底，保证顺序稳定
  events: {
    select: {
      type: true,
      fromStatus: true,
      toStatus: true,
      content: true,
      createdAt: true,
      actor: { select: { displayName: true } },
    },
    orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
  },
  // 只要告警数量，不取告警明细
  _count: { select: { alerts: true } },
} satisfies Prisma.TicketSelect;

// 返回值类型由 select 推导出来，select 改了类型自动跟着变
export type TicketDetail = Prisma.TicketGetPayload<{ select: typeof ticketDetailSelect }>;

// 列表页每行只显示这几列，不取描述和处理记录
// id 只用来生成游标，返回前会去掉，不出现在接口里
const ticketListSelect = {
  id: true,
  ticketNo: true,
  title: true,
  status: true,
  priority: true,
  slaDueAt: true,
  createdAt: true,
  assignee: { select: { displayName: true } },
} satisfies Prisma.TicketSelect;

type TicketListRow = Prisma.TicketGetPayload<{ select: typeof ticketListSelect }>;
export type TicketListItem = Omit<TicketListRow, 'id'>;

export interface TicketPage {
  items: TicketListItem[];
  // 还有下一页时给出游标，原样传回即可取下一页；没有下一页时为 null
  nextCursor: string | null;
}

const versionConflict = () =>
  new ConflictException({ code: 'VERSION_CONFLICT', message: '工单已被其他人修改，请刷新后再操作' });

// 每个处理人同时处理中的工单上限
export const MAX_PROCESSING_PER_ASSIGNEE = 5;
// 接单上限：一个人同时最多处理 MAX_PROCESSING_PER_ASSIGNEE 张工单（跨多行的规则，CHECK 约束做不到）
// 接单和改派（D14）共用；调用方的事务必须是可串行化的，否则并发时会出现写偏斜（D9）
async function assertUnderProcessingLimit(tx: TransactionClient, assigneeId: string): Promise<void> {
  const processing = await tx.ticket.count({ where: { assigneeId, status: 'processing' } });
  if (processing >= MAX_PROCESSING_PER_ASSIGNEE) {
    throw new ConflictException({
      code: 'ASSIGNEE_LIMIT_REACHED',
      message: `已有 ${processing} 张处理中的工单，达到上限 ${MAX_PROCESSING_PER_ASSIGNEE}`,
    });
  }
}

// 批量指派等锁最多等多久：超时返回 409，而不是让请求一直挂着（D12）
export const BATCH_LOCK_TIMEOUT = '2s';

// 审计里记录的工单状态：只记会被这些操作改变的几个字段（D18）
function snapshot(t: { status: string; assignee: { username: string } | null; version: number }) {
  return { status: t.status, assignee: t.assignee?.username ?? null, version: t.version };
}

const notInGroup = (displayName: string) =>
  new ConflictException({ code: 'ASSIGNEE_NOT_IN_GROUP', message: `${displayName}不在这张工单所在的班组` });

// 把 groupScope() 的结果翻译成原生 SQL 的条件（D17），和 Prisma where 里的规则保持一致
function groupCondition(scope: GroupScope): Prisma.Sql {
  if ('groupId' in scope) {
    return Prisma.sql`AND group_id = ${scope.groupId}::uuid`;
  }
  if ('id' in scope) {
    return Prisma.sql`AND false`;
  }
  return Prisma.empty;
}

@Injectable()
export class TicketsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly stats: TicketStatsService,
    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,
  ) {}

  // 工单列表：按状态、优先级、处理人筛选，按创建时间倒序，游标分页
  // 对应索引 tickets_status_created_at_id_idx 和 tickets_assignee_status_idx
  // scope 是当前用户能看的班组（D17），和筛选条件一起放进 where，游标、筛选参数怎么传都绕不过它
  async list(query: ListTicketsQuery, scope: GroupScope): Promise<TicketPage> {
    const where: Prisma.TicketWhereInput = {
      ...scope,
      status: query.status,
      priority: query.priority,
      // 按处理人的用户名筛选：Prisma 生成 LEFT JOIN users，在同一条 SQL 里按用户名过滤
      ...(query.assignee ? { assignee: { username: query.assignee } } : {}),
    };

    if (query.cursor) {
      const cursor = decodeCursor(query.cursor);
      // 只取排在游标之后的行：时间更早，或者时间相同但 id 更小
      // 外层的 lte 条件和 OR 等价，多写一次是为了让索引能用上时间范围，而不是从头扫描
      where.AND = [
        { createdAt: { lte: cursor.time } },
        {
          OR: [
            { createdAt: { lt: cursor.time } },
            { createdAt: cursor.time, id: { lt: cursor.id } },
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // 多取一行：取到了说明还有下一页，这一行不返回
    const rows = await this.prisma.ticket.findMany({
      where,
      select: ticketListSelect,
      // 排序必须和游标条件、索引的顺序完全一致
      orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
      take: query.limit + 1,
    });

    const hasMore = rows.length > query.limit;
    const pageRows = hasMore ? rows.slice(0, query.limit) : rows;
    const last = pageRows.at(-1);

    return {
      items: pageRows.map(({ id: _id, ...item }) => item),
      nextCursor: hasMore && last ? encodeCursor({ time: last.createdAt, id: last.id }) : null,
    };
  }

  // 执行一次状态流转：改工单状态和追加处理记录放在同一个事务里，要么都成功，要么都不生效
  async transition(ticketNo: string, dto: TransitionTicketDto, username: string, scope: GroupScope,
    beforeTransition?: (tx: TransactionClient, actorId: string) => Promise<Prisma.TicketWhereInput>): Promise<TicketDetail> {
    const actor = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!actor) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(`用户 ${username} 不存在`);
    }

    // 接单上限是跨多行的规则，读已提交下会出现写偏斜（D9 实测），所以用可串行化并在冲突时重试
    const { detail, previousAssigneeId } = await this.prisma.serializable(async (tx) => {
      // 审批消费与工单写入使用同一事务，冲突时整组回滚。
      const permitted = beforeTransition ? await beforeTransition(tx, actor.id) : scope;
      // 别的班组的工单和不存在的工单一样：404（D17）
      const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({
        where: { ticketNo, ...permitted },
        // assignee 只用来记审计里的“改之前”（D18）
        select: { id: true, status: true, version: true, assigneeId: true, assignee: { select: { username: true } } },
      });
      if (!ticket) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`工单 ${ticketNo} 不存在`);
      }
      // 先比版本：用户看到的已经不是最新的工单了，他的判断依据过期了，不管这个动作现在是否合法都应该先刷新
      if (ticket.version !== dto.version) {
        throw versionConflict();
      }

      if (dto.action === 'accept') {
        await assertUnderProcessingLimit(tx, actor.id);
      }


      let plan;
      try {
        plan = planTransition(
          { status: ticket.status as TicketStatus },
          dto.action,
          actor.id,
          new Date(),
          dto.comment,
        );
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof InvalidTransitionError) {
          throw new ConflictException({ code: 'INVALID_TRANSITION', message: error.message });
        }
        throw error;
      }

      // 乐观锁：只有版本号还是客户端看到的那个，才执行修改，同时把版本号加一
      // 条件和修改在同一条 UPDATE 里完成，没有“先查再改”的时间窗口
      const { count } = await tx.ticket.updateMany({
        where: { id: ticket.id, version: dto.version },
        data: { ...plan.update, version: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      if (count === 0) {
        throw versionConflict();
      }
      await tx.ticketEvent.create({ data: { ...plan.event, ticketId: ticket.id } });

      // 返回流转后的详情，前端不用再请求一次
      const detail = await tx.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ticket.id }, select: ticketDetailSelect });
      // 审计和业务写在同一个事务里（D18）：可串行化冲突重试时，上一次尝试写的审计也一起回滚
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        actorId: actor.id,
        actorUsername: username,
        action: `ticket.${dto.action}`,
        entityType: 'ticket',
        entityKey: ticketNo,
        before: snapshot({ status: ticket.status, assignee: ticket.assignee, version: ticket.version }),
        after: snapshot(detail),
      });
      return { detail, previousAssigneeId: ticket.assigneeId };
    });
    // 提交之后（D28）：流转后的处理人要么没变、要么是操作人（接单），两个人的“我的工单”都删掉
    await this.stats.invalidateMine([previousAssigneeId, actor.id]);
    return detail;
  }

  // 改派（D14 变式练习）：处理中的工单换一个处理人，状态不变
  // 用到了 W2 的全部机制：事务（D8）、可串行化防写偏斜（D9）、版本号（D10）
  async reassign(ticketNo: string, dto: ReassignTicketDto, username: string, scope: GroupScope): Promise<TicketDetail> {
    const actor = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!actor) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(`用户 ${username} 不存在`);
    }
    const target = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { username: dto.assignee },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true, groupId: true },
    });
    if (!target) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`用户 ${dto.assignee} 不存在`);
    }

    // 新处理人的接单上限是跨多行的规则，和接单一样用可串行化
    const { detail, previousAssigneeId } = await this.prisma.serializable(async (tx) => {
      const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({
        where: { ticketNo, ...scope },
        select: {
          id: true,
          status: true,
          version: true,
          assigneeId: true,
          groupId: true,
          assignee: { select: { username: true } },
        },
      });
      if (!ticket) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`工单 ${ticketNo} 不存在`);
      }
      if (ticket.version !== dto.version) {
        throw versionConflict();
      }
      if (ticket.status !== 'processing') {
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'INVALID_TRANSITION',
          message: `只能改派处理中的工单，当前状态为 ${ticket.status}`,
        });
      }
      if (ticket.assigneeId === target.id) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'SAME_ASSIGNEE', message: `工单已经由${target.displayName}处理` });
      }
      // 只能改派给工单所在班组的人：派给别的班组的人，他自己反而看不到这张工单（D17）
      if (target.groupId !== ticket.groupId) {
        throw notInGroup(target.displayName);
      }
      await assertUnderProcessingLimit(tx, target.id);

      const { count } = await tx.ticket.updateMany({
        where: { id: ticket.id, version: dto.version },
        data: { assigneeId: target.id, version: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      if (count === 0) {
        throw versionConflict();
      }
      await tx.ticketEvent.create({
        data: {
          ticketId: ticket.id,
          actorId: actor.id,
          type: 'assigned',
          content: `改派给${target.displayName}：${dto.reason}`,
        },
      });
      const detail = await tx.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ticket.id }, select: ticketDetailSelect });
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        actorId: actor.id,
        actorUsername: username,
        action: 'ticket.reassign',
        entityType: 'ticket',
        entityKey: ticketNo,
        before: snapshot(ticket),
        // 改派的原因也记下来：审计要回答“为什么”
        after: { ...snapshot(detail), reason: dto.reason },
      });
      // 通知新处理人（D31）：写进 Outbox，和改派一起提交；改派回滚了，这条通知也不会发
      await this.outbox.record(tx, {
        type: 'ticket.assigned',
        payload: { ticketNo, assigneeId: target.id, assignedBy: username },
      });
      return { detail, previousAssigneeId: ticket.assigneeId };
    });
    // 提交之后（D28）：原处理人少了一张，新处理人多了一张
    await this.stats.invalidateMine([previousAssigneeId, target.id]);
    return detail;
  }

  // 评论（D21 变式练习）：给工单追加一条 comment 类型的处理记录，不改状态、不改版本号
  // 用到了 W3 的全部机制：权限点（控制器上）、班组范围（D17）、审计（D18）、日志级脱敏（D19）
  async comment(ticketNo: string, dto: CommentTicketDto, username: string, scope: GroupScope): Promise<TicketDetail> {
    const actor = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!actor) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(`用户 ${username} 不存在`);
    }
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ticketNo, ...scope }, select: { id: true, status: true } });
      if (!ticket) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`工单 ${ticketNo} 不存在`);
      }
      if (ticket.status === 'closed' || ticket.status === 'cancelled') {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TICKET_CLOSED', message: '工单已结束，不能再评论' });
      }
      await tx.ticketEvent.create({
        data: { ticketId: ticket.id, actorId: actor.id, type: 'comment', content: dto.content },
      });
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        actorId: actor.id,
        actorUsername: username,
        action: 'ticket.comment',
        entityType: 'ticket',
        entityKey: ticketNo,
        // 评论是自由文本，可能写着手机号：审计里只留擦掉敏感内容后的文本
        after: { content: redactForLog(dto.content) },
      });
      return tx.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ticket.id }, select: ticketDetailSelect });
    });
  }

  // 批量指派：一批待处理的工单指派给同一个人，要么全部成功，要么一张都不改
  async batchAssign(dto: BatchAssignDto, username: string, scope: GroupScope): Promise<{ count: number }> {
    const actor = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!actor) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(`用户 ${username} 不存在`);
    }
    const assignee = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { username: dto.assignee },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true, groupId: true },
    });
    if (!assignee) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`用户 ${dto.assignee} 不存在`);
    }

    const { count, previousAssigneeIds } = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // 只对当前事务生效（第三个参数 true），提交或回滚后自动恢复
      await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT set_config('lock_timeout', ${BATCH_LOCK_TIMEOUT}, true)`;

      // 一条语句按工单编号排序、一次锁住全部：所有批量指派都按同一个顺序加锁，互相之间就不会死锁
      // 锁住之后再检查状态，检查和修改之间别人改不了这些工单
      // 原生 SQL 用不了 Prisma 的 where，班组条件要自己拼进去（D17）。别的班组的工单查不到，按“不存在”报告
      const locked = await tx.$queryRaw<
        { id: string; ticket_no: string; status: string; group_id: string; assignee_id: string | null; version: number }[]
      >`
        SELECT id, ticket_no, status, group_id, assignee_id, version FROM tickets
        WHERE ticket_no = ANY(${dto.ticketNos}) ${groupCondition(scope)}
        ORDER BY ticket_no
        FOR UPDATE`;

      if (locked.length !== dto.ticketNos.length) {
        const found = new Set(locked.map((t) => t.ticket_no));
        throw new NotFoundException(`工单不存在：${dto.ticketNos.filter((no) => !found.has(no)).join('、')}`);
      }
      const notPending = locked.filter((t) => t.status !== 'pending');
      if (notPending.length > 0) {
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'INVALID_TRANSITION',
          message: `只能指派待处理的工单：${notPending.map((t) => `${t.ticket_no}（${t.status}）`).join('、')}`,
        });
      }

      if (locked.some((t) => t.group_id !== assignee.groupId)) {
        throw notInGroup(assignee.displayName);
      }

      const ids = locked.map((t) => t.id);
      // 版本号也要加一：别人正开着这些工单的详情页，他们看到的已经过期了（D10）
      await tx.ticket.updateMany({
        where: { id: { in: ids } },
        data: { assigneeId: assignee.id, version: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      await tx.ticketEvent.createMany({
        data: ids.map((ticketId) => ({
          ticketId,
          actorId: actor.id,
          type: 'assigned',
          content: `指派给${assignee.displayName}`,
        })),
      });
      // 每张工单一条审计（D18）：按工单查时间线时，批量操作也能查到
      const previous = await tx.user.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: locked.flatMap((t) => (t.assignee_id ? [t.assignee_id] : [])) } },
        select: { id: true, username: true },
      });
      const usernameOf = new Map(previous.map((u) => [u.id, u.username]));
      for (const t of locked) {
        await this.audit.record(tx, {
          actorId: actor.id,
          actorUsername: username,
          action: 'ticket.batch_assign',
          entityType: 'ticket',
          entityKey: t.ticket_no,
          before: { status: t.status, assignee: t.assignee_id ? (usernameOf.get(t.assignee_id) ?? null) : null, version: t.version },
          after: { status: t.status, assignee: dto.assignee, version: t.version + 1 },
        });
        // 每张工单一个通知事件（D31），和指派在同一个事务里
        await this.outbox.record(tx, {
          type: 'ticket.assigned',
          payload: { ticketNo: t.ticket_no, assigneeId: assignee.id, assignedBy: username },
        });
      }
      return { count: ids.length, previousAssigneeIds: locked.map((t) => t.assignee_id) };
    });
    // 提交之后（D28）：新处理人，以及这些工单原来的处理人
    await this.stats.invalidateMine([assignee.id, ...previousAssigneeIds]);
    return { count };
  }

  async findDetail(ticketNo: string, scope: GroupScope): Promise<TicketDetail> {
    // 看不到的工单返回和不存在完全一样的 404，不透露这张工单存在（D17）
    const ticket = await this.prisma.ticket.findFirst({
      where: { ticketNo, ...scope },
      select: ticketDetailSelect,
    });
    if (!ticket) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`工单 ${ticketNo} 不存在`);
    }
    return ticket;
  }
}

apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts

import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../src/app.setup.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';

describe('关单申请的公开接口', () => {
  let app: INestApplication, db: PrismaService, fixtures: TicketFixtures, api: ReturnType<typeof request>;
  let login: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof tokenIssuer>>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    app = (await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile()).createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app); await app.init(); db = app.get(PrismaService); api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'CLS'); login = await tokenIssuer(app);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'CLS' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup(); await app.close();
  });
  async function setup(username: 'bob' | 'carol' | 'dave' = 'bob') {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create({ status: 'processing', assigneeUsername: 'bob' });
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { status: 'resolved', resolvedAt: new Date() } });
    const owner = login(username);
    const run = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', owner)
      .send({ ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, requestKey: randomUUID(), goal: '提交关单复核' }).expect(201);
    const url = '/api/agent/runs/' + run.body.data.id + '/close-requests';
    const record = await db.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ticket.id } });
    const terms = { requestKey: randomUUID(), version: record.version, comment: '已复核恢复记录' };
    const submit = () => api.post(url).set('authorization', owner).send(terms);
    return { ticket, terms, submit, url, owner };
  }
  it('相同业务键重试返回同一份审批快照', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const first = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    expect(first.state).toBe('pending');
    expect((await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id).toBe(first.id);
    await api.post(flow.url).set('authorization', flow.owner).send({ ...flow.terms, comment: '另一项说明' }).expect(409);
    const url = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + first.id;
    expect((await api.get(url).set('authorization', login('carol')).expect(200)).body.data.comment).toBe(flow.terms.comment);
    expect((await api.post(url + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201)).body.data.state).toBe('approved');
  });
  it('只读员工不能提单且组长不能自审', async () => {
    const reader = await setup('dave'); await reader.submit().expect(403);
    const flow = await setup('carol');
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await api.post('/api/agent/close-requests/' + row.id + '/approve').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(403);
    expect((await db.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } })).state).toBe('pending');
  });
  it('并发执行只关闭一次并留下两位参与人的审计', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const id = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id;
    const base = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + id;
    await api.post(base + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201);
    const execute = () => api.post(base + '/execute').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({});
    const receipts = await Promise.all([execute(), execute()]);
    expect(receipts.map(r => r.status).sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual([201, 409]);
    const events = await db.ticketEvent.findMany({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } });
    expect(events).toHaveLength(1); expect(events[0].content).toBe(flow.terms.comment);
    const audit = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo } });
    expect(audit.map(r => [r.action, r.actorUsername])).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
      ['agent.close_requested','bob'], ['agent.close_approved','carol'], ['agent.close_executed','bob'], ['ticket.close','bob'],
    ]));
  });
  it('超过十分钟的审批不能消费', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const base = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + row.id;
    await api.post(base + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201);
    // 只替换应用的日期；HTTP 和连接池仍使用真实定时器。
    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] });
    try {
      vi.setSystemTime(new Date(new Date(row.expiresAt).getTime() + 1));
      await api.post(base + '/execute').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(409);
      expect((await db.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: flow.ticket.id } })).status).toBe('resolved');
      expect(await db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } })).toBe(0);
    } finally { vi.useRealTimers(); }
  });
  it('工单版本变化会回滚审批消费和执行审计', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const id = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id;
    const base = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + id;
    await api.post(base + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201);
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: flow.ticket.id }, data: { version: { increment: 1 } } });
    await api.post(base + '/execute').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(409);
    expect((await db.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } })).state).toBe('approved');
    expect(await db.auditLog.count({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo, action: 'agent.close_executed' } })).toBe(0);
  });
});

五、核心面试题

  1. 两个浏览器同时点击执行会发生什么？　要点：两个请求争用同一批准和工单版本，只有一个可以提交；另一个遇到状态冲突。
  2. 为什么版本冲突时申请还应显示 approved？　要点：申请确实经过批准，但这次执行没有完成。
  3. 怎样证明 Agent 的“已关闭”真的生效了？　要点：检查工单的最终状态与版本、唯一处理记录和带同一批准编号的审计。
